entries.title: Blasphemous
entries.definitive_edition: Blasphemous on Windows PC with all free updates through Wounds of Eventide

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with all free content updates.

primary.version: Current PC build with The Stir of Dawn, Strife and Ruin, and Wounds of Eventide
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it includes the complete modern content set and keeps PC fidelity/capture flexibility. The critical content is the three free expansions: The Stir of Dawn, Strife and Ruin, and Wounds of Eventide, with Wounds of Eventide adding the ending that leads directly into Blasphemous 2. The Android/iOS version also bundles all free DLC, but PC remains the better archival route for controls, capture, and display.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Blasphemous on Windows PC and update to the current build. For the full story route, play with The Stir of Dawn, Strife and Ruin, and Wounds of Eventide installed, and plan the Wounds of Eventide requirements before locking yourself out of its ending path.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented. The main caveat is route planning: Wounds of Eventide has story-ending requirements, so do not treat a casual late save as the full route without checking those conditions.

entries.title: Blasphemous 2
entries.definitive_edition: Blasphemous 2 Complete Sacrament Edition / Windows PC with Mea Culpa and The Third Sin

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native 2D PC presentation with Mea Culpa and The Third Sin content.

primary.version: Complete Sacrament Edition / Mea Culpa plus The Third Sin update
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because it combines the base game, paid Mea Culpa expansion, and the free 2026 The Third Sin expansion with PC capture/settings flexibility. Mea Culpa adds two zones, two bosses, quests, an alternate ending, and the returning Mea Culpa weapon; The Third Sin adds a major free castle area, blade-tipped whip, Familiars, new prayers, outfits, achievements, and music. PS4 is specifically not the best current route because The Third Sin was announced for PS4 later than the other platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Blasphemous 2 Complete Sacrament Edition on Steam, or buy the Windows PC base game plus Mea Culpa, then update to include the free The Third Sin expansion before a complete run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with Steam/Epic/GOG routes, Mea Culpa DLC, and The Third Sin free update.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete PC route with the paid and free expansion content plus capture/settings flexibility.
